description: We are a passionate team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge to build an innovative solution using NASA open data to solve real-world space and Earth challenges.
summary: Our project is an educational storytelling video created for school students to explore NASA's historic spacecraft, rovers, and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon and Mars. Since the 1960s, these pioneering machines have completed vital missions, uncovered secrets of our solar system, and remained as silent monuments on other worlds. Through engaging visuals and clear explanations based on verified NASA archives, our video brings these forgotten explorers back to life, showing students what each mission achieved, how they operated, and why their scientific legacy continues to inspire future space exploration.
details: Our project is an educational storytelling video designed to introduce school students to NASA's historic rovers, landers, and instruments left on the Moon and Mars. Using verified data and archival imagery from NASA missions such as Apollo, Spirit, Opportunity, and InSight, we crafted a clear narrative explaining each spacecraft's purpose, discoveries, and current status. The video was developed using modern video editing and graphic design tools to simplify space science concepts, making space history engaging, accessible, and inspiring for young learners.
